hypotheses.C0_all_cells_are_balanced: Every family/fold/split contains equal edit orientations and at least forty examples.
hypotheses.C1_spelling_positive_control_transfers: Disjoint spelling targets shift correctly on at least 75% of examples in every fold/split cell.
hypotheses.C2_human_semantic_families_are_transfera: At least four of five declared semantic families shift disjoint same-family targets correctly on at least 60% of examples in every fold/split cell.
hypotheses.C3_declared_family_contrasts_beat_random: For every transferable family cell, the declared contrast is at or above the 95th percentile of frozen balanced random signings.
hypotheses.C4_transfer_strength_tracks_short_termin: Across spelling plus five declared families, mean cross-pair win rate correlates at most -0.5 with mean terminal joint k90.
